documents.text:
# Grant Compliance Conditions

The Aldermoor Foundation (the "Funder") and Harrowgate Institute of Marine Science (the "Grantee").

## 7. Records

7.1 The Grantee shall maintain monthly timesheets for every member of staff funded by the Grant.

7.2 The Grantee shall obtain ethics committee approval before commencing any fieldwork.

7.3 The Grantee shall keep receipts for all equipment purchases above £500.

documents.title: Compliance Evidence Pack - Year 1
documents.text:
# Compliance Evidence Pack - Year 1

Item 1: Monthly timesheets for funded staff. Timesheets enclosed for 4 of the 6 funded staff members; timesheets for the two postdoctoral researchers were not located.

Item 2: Equipment receipts. Receipts enclosed for all three equipment purchases above £500 (CTD sensor, sampling winch, freezer).

# Kitchen Compliance Schedule

Saffron Table Catering LLP (the "Caterer") and Brightwater Conference Centre Ltd (the "Venue").

## 2. Compliance

2.2 The Caterer shall arrange pest control inspections every quarter.

2.3 The Caterer shall have its fire suppression system serviced annually.

Lumen Stageworks Ltd (the "Producer") and Kestrel Music Festival CIC (the "Organiser").
